tasks.CheckDivisibilityByBetty: Checking if the number of students is not divisible by any integer between 2 and 49 (excluding 1 and the number itself).
tasks.CheckDivisibilityByWilma: Checking if adding two to the number of students results in a number that is also not divisible by any integer between 2 and 49 (excluding 1 and the number itself).
